related.title: OSU Micro-Benchmarks：往返平均與單向延遲語義
related.titleEn: OSU Micro-Benchmarks: round-trip averages and one-way semantics
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告保留19.2→17.4及12→10兩種結果；下一輪設計有可驗證的控制條件，未宣稱已取得顯著性。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both mean and median changes remain visible; the next experiment has explicit controls and no unsupported significance claim.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「OSU Micro-Benchmarks：往返平均與單向延遲語義」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付ping-pong事件表、warmup分界、配置與資料校驗結果；報告寫平均半往返估計，不把它冒充純網路傳播或尾延遲。
related.differenceEn: Investigate OSU Micro-Benchmarks: round-trip averages and one-way semantics using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a ping-pong event ledger, warmup boundary, configuration and payload checks. Label the number as an average half-round-trip estimate rather than pure propagation delay or a tail-latency percentile.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐筆加總10、11、12、13、50，保存96ms總和；再處理候選87ms。另算刪50後平均11.5ms，標明這是未授權篩選造成不同問題。
先以一次往返12微秒畫時間線，得到平均6；再將100次總1200微秒計算，與錯誤1200/100並列，說明兩者分別回答什麼。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Sum all five baseline values to retain the 96 ms total and repeat for the 87 ms candidate total. Deliberately compute the 11.5 ms mean after dropping fifty and identify it as a different, unjustified selection rather than a corrected result.

Draw a single twelve-microsecond round trip to obtain a six-microsecond half-trip average. Extend the reasoning to one hundred trips totaling 1200 microseconds, and contrast division by one hundred with division by two hundred without conflating the resulting quantities.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Fugaku：層級故障域中的碎片分散
related.titleEn: Fugaku: shard placement across hierarchical failure domains
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告保留19.2→17.4及12→10兩種結果；下一輪設計有可驗證的控制條件，未宣稱已取得顯著性。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both mean and median changes remain visible; the next experiment has explicit controls and no unsupported significance claim.
related.difference: 每個 shard_id 必須只有一個 board_id 與 rack_id；列舉每塊板被移除後剩餘的碎片，而非只畫機櫃外觀。
related.differenceEn: Assign every shard_id exactly one board_id and rack_id, then enumerate survivors after removing each board. Preserve the hierarchy so a later rack-level analysis cannot mistake different boards for independent racks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐筆加總10、11、12、13、50，保存96ms總和；再處理候選87ms。另算刪50後平均11.5ms，標明這是未授權篩選造成不同問題。
最壞單板損失比例為該板碎片數最大值除以全部碎片數；此比例描述暴露面，不代表系統失效機率；十二個等大且互異的碎片，名義每板四片分三板；變更每板兩片分六板；名義式 4/12*100 = 33.3333333333 %；變更式 2/12*100 = 16.6666666667 %。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Sum all five baseline values to retain the 96 ms total and repeat for the 87 ms candidate total. Deliberately compute the 11.5 ms mean after dropping fifty and identify it as a different, unjustified selection rather than a corrected result.

Worst single-board exposure is the largest shard count in one board divided by the total number of shards. It measures placement exposure, not failure probability or recoverability without a separate redundancy contract. Place twelve equal-sized, distinct shards across three teaching boards with four shards per board, then across six boards with two each. This deliberately reduced hierarchy is separate from Fugaku’s published hardware counts. Nominal 4/12*100 = 33.3333333333 %; changed 2/12*100 = 16.6666666667 %. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
